mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, SELLER_ID, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, IMAGE_PATH) VALUES ( PRODUCT_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{category}, #{price}, #{description}, #{sellerId}, #{latitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{longitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{imagePath} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT WHERE CATEGORY = #{category} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
